{{- /* User static (params.mdfriday.userStatic) → relURL; else theme CDN via asset partial */ -}} {{- $path := . -}} {{- if not $path -}} {{- else if or (hasPrefix $path "http://") (hasPrefix $path "https://") (hasPrefix $path "//") -}} {{- $path -}} {{- else -}} {{- $userStatic := (Site).Params.mdfriday.userStatic | default dict -}} {{- if index $userStatic $path -}} {{- $path | relURL -}} {{- else -}} {{- partial "asset" $path -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}}
